author: /root/audit_build_ops
authorization: Root explicitly transferred the redaction pair and subsequently the trade/state-test pair. No other source scope was changed.
behavior: Bounded RPC disclosure guard checks every nonempty repeated/short query value and literal/decoded/encoded representations. Empty values do not match all endpoints. Prior userinfo/full-query/long host/path checks remain.
Fixed action history has at most fund/release/refund, one record per kind. The marker is saved before gas estimation/Forge; failures/current absence cannot authorize repeating the same kind.

Legacy fund/settle/failedSends evidence is copied into its named fixed kind without overwriting a prior kind. Unknown legacy kinds or ambiguity fail closed; imported history can restrict, not establish native state or fiat facts.

Native proven funding retains its first distinct exit under the existing chain/actor/time checks. A prior release does not prevent the first timeout refund. Unknown prior release evidence remains alongside the refund attempt.
Successful canonical terminal observations end read-only processing without economic sends; summary enrichment cannot discard the separate attempt history.
No resend flag, generic journal, fake nonce proof, send retry, native harness weakening, production pin or scanner change.

intermediateDiagnosis.reason: First implementation run11/12: the new test wrongly required the mutable fund summary to remain exactly unchanged, but existing canonical receipt readback legitimately adds block/blockHash. The assertion was corrected to retain every preexisting field while allowing native enrichment; immutable per-kind history retention remains exact. Original intermediate log retained.

limits: All tests use controlled public fixtures and intercepted RPC/send boundaries. No external endpoint request, real Forge send, deployment, signing or resource provisioning occurred.
Root owns full-suite and native Anvil/harness validation after integration. The source author cannot independently approve this repair.
RPC disclosure checks are conservative: a short/generic nonempty private query value can reject a keyless endpoint. There is no provider-specific credential-field schema.
Attempt records are process-resume safeguards in an editable local CLI document; no new malicious-file integrity, multi-process concurrency or filesystem power-loss qualification is claimed.
